title: Reviewer re-types the decision packet onto live-review/rows; a dropped field makes the mirror refuse the row. Commit packet+table byte-exact by machine; the reviewer writes only its row
note: OBSERVED 2026-10-27 19:20Z (manager): the first per-row review LR-20261027T1831Z-pkg-976b459f5c954df0 (MHG hold, rows/ commit 3cd661fb5) was seen by the VM watcher (rows_watch_status file_rows 1, rows 27, bad_files 0) but live-review-rows-mirror runs 40563006909 and later skipped it: 'packet_sha does not match'. CAUSE (MEASURED): the reviewer re-typed the 5,316 B canonical packet into comms/live_review/packets/<id>.json (commit 8528cc37d) and dropped one key, "sd_r":null, at byte 4211; the row's packet_sha 2a160fa4... is the generator's sha. The table copy (5f491e5e0) happened to be byte-exact. Same echo-fidelity class as 3f1546c2d (LTR-ROWS-SWAP-TRUNCATION). REPAIRED: e09367cb5 on live-review/rows writes the generator's packet (canonical sha verified = 2a160fa4...). FIX (Tier 2): commit the packet and outcome table to live-review/rows by machine when the LTR wake marker fires (the shape desk-scan-packet.yml already uses for desk/decisions), and change REVIEWER-BRIEF.md section 4 so the reviewer writes ONLY comms/live_review/rows/<review_id>.json (copying packet_sha), never the packet/table. INTERIM: the manager commits the packet+table byte-exact itself before spawning a reviewer. Also seen, pre-existing: legacy row LR-20261026T2311Z-pkg-6a8e3fb325464be3 is schema-refused by the mirror on every run (review_id ends with a different package id; basis insufficient_n on a real-money row) - not mirrored since 2026-10-26; disposition in the same lane (kill with reason or repair). CLOSES WHEN: a reviewer spawned from a marker writes only its row file, the mirror run after it reports mirrored >= 1 with no packet_sha skip, and a test covers the machine-written packet path. [2026-10-27 20:30Z lane] BUILT on branch claude/ltr-packet-echo (Tier 2, landing hold). (1) scripts/ops/live_review_wake.py land_evidence: each built packet + outcome table committed byte-exact (generator --write format) to live-review/rows as ONE fast-forward git-data commit, create-only, BEFORE the ltr-wake comment; shared by the VM poster (its existing extraheader credential; the same API path desk_packet_wake.py already uses on desk/decisions, MEASURED working: 'Ben desk: scan packet' commits) and the Actions poller (GITHUB_TOKEN, contents: write). VM: failed commit posts nothing + 10 min backoff, the poller covers; poller: failed commit posts packet_state could_not_commit with no packet block. (2) REVIEWER-BRIEF s4 + SKILL Step 6: reviewer reads that its packet exists and writes ONLY rows/<review_id>.json; never packets/ or tables/. (3) mirror: packet_sha mismatch -> ::error + ONE ops-flags ltr-mirror-refused comment per review_id, run stays green; missing cited packet: retried every run, flagged once, run red as before. (4) LR-20261026T2311Z-pkg-6a8e3fb325464be3 KILLED in comms/live_review/killed_rows.json (wrong-package lane error, superseded by LR-20261026T2312Z-pkg-6a8e3fb325464be3). Verified on real data: the machine format of the incident packet passes packet_blob_problems (sha 2a160fa4...), the re-typed 8528cc37d blob is refused; mirror on the live rows branch now: mirrored 1 (LR-20261027T1831Z), skipped 0, killed 1. MERGED: no. DEPLOYED: no.
